Why the Moon Changes Shape.zh: 月亮为什么会改变形状

Space for curious kids.zh: 写给好奇的小朋友的天文课

Why does the Moon change shape?.zh: 月亮为什么会改变形状？
Why does the Moon change shape?.src: Why does the Moon change shape?

The Moon is always a round ball. What ch.zh: 月亮始终是一个圆球。发生变化的是：从地球上能看到的、月亮被太阳照亮的那一部分。拖动月亮，观察光线如何变化，并认识各个相位的名称。
The Moon is always a round ball. What ch.src:
The Moon is always a round ball. What changes is the part of the Moon's sunlit side
              that we can see from Earth. Drag the Moon, watch the light move, and learn the phase names.

@@T0@@The Sun lights it@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@太阳照亮它@@T1@@
                @@T2@@月亮自己不会发光。@@T3@@
@@T0@@The Sun lights it@@T1@@\n.src: The Sun lights it The Moon does not glow by itself.

@@T0@@Half is always lit@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@总有一半被照亮@@T1@@
                @@T2@@明亮的那一半始终朝向太阳。@@T3@@
@@T0@@Half is always lit@@T1@@\n.src: Half is always lit The bright half always faces the Sun.

@@T0@@We see an angle@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@我们看到的是一个角度@@T1@@
                @@T2@@位置不同，我们看到的受光部分多少也不同。@@T3@@
@@T0@@We see an angle@@T1@@\n.src: We see an angle Different positions show us different amounts of light.

@@T0@@Start exploring@@T1@@\n.src: Start exploring Try the Moon game

A full Moon happens when the Moon is on.zh: 当地球位于月亮与太阳之间、月亮处在地球的远侧时，我们就几乎能看到它被照亮的全部，这就是满月。
A full Moon happens when the Moon is on.src: A full Moon happens when the Moon is on the far side of Earth, so we see almost all of its lit half.

This is the big idea: the Moon goes arou.zh: 这就是最核心的想法：月亮绕着地球转，太阳只照亮它的一面，而我们的视角在不断改变。
This is the big idea: the Moon goes arou.src: This is the big idea: the Moon goes around Earth, the Sun lights one side, and our view changes.

Drag the small Moon around its path..zh: 沿着轨道拖动那个小月亮。
Drag the small Moon around its path..src: Drag the small Moon around its path.

Watch the big Moon on the right..src: Watch the big Moon on the right.

Notice which side is bright and how much.zh: 留意哪一侧是亮的，以及你能看到其中多少。
Notice which side is bright and how much.src: Notice which side is bright and how much of it you can see.

The Sun is on the left. Earth is in the.zh: 太阳在左边，地球在中间。月亮大约用一个月的时间绕地球一圈。
The Sun is on the left. Earth is in the.src: The Sun is on the left. Earth is in the middle. The Moon goes around Earth in about a month.

About day 15 of 29.5.zh: 约为 29.5 天中的第 15 天

Sun, Earth, and Moon from above.zh: 俯视下的太阳、地球与月亮
Sun, Earth, and Moon from above.src: Sun, Earth, and Moon from above

Drag the Moon around its circle. The sun.zh: 拖动月亮沿圆圈运动。阳光始终从左边照来。
Drag the Moon around its circle. The sun.src: Drag the Moon around its circle. The sunlight always comes from the left.

The whole face looks bright because the.zh: 整个盘面看起来都是亮的，因为被照亮的那一半正对着我们。
The whole face looks bright because the.src: The whole face looks bright because the lit half is facing us.

Bright part we can see: 100%.zh: 我们能看到的明亮部分：100%

Click any phase card to jump there in th.zh: 点击任意一张相位卡片，即可在探索器中跳转到该位置。
Click any phase card to jump there in th.src: Click any phase card to jump there in the explorer.

@@T0@@New Moon@@T1@@\n @@T2@@.zh:
@@T0@@新月@@T1@@
            @@T2@@我们几乎只看到黑暗的一面。@@T3@@
@@T0@@New Moon@@T1@@\n @@T2@@.src: New Moon We mostly see the dark side.

@@T0@@Waxing Crescent@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@娥眉月@@T1@@
            @@T2@@一道细细的明亮「微笑」开始变大。@@T3@@
@@T0@@Waxing Crescent@@T1@@\n.src: Waxing Crescent A slim bright smile starts to grow.

@@T0@@First Quarter@@T1@@\n @.zh:
@@T0@@上弦月@@T1@@
            @@T2@@看起来有一半是亮的。此时月亮走完了轨道的四分之一。@@T3@@
@@T0@@First Quarter@@T1@@\n @.src: First Quarter Half looks bright. The Moon is a quarter of the way around.

@@T0@@Waxing Gibbous@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@盈凸月@@T1@@
            @@T2@@超过一半是亮的，并且仍在变大。@@T3@@
@@T0@@Waxing Gibbous@@T1@@\n.src: Waxing Gibbous More than half is bright and still growing.

@@T0@@Full Moon@@T1@@\n @@T2@.zh:
@@T0@@满月@@T1@@
            @@T2@@明亮的一面几乎完全朝向我们。@@T3@@
@@T0@@Full Moon@@T1@@\n @@T2@.src: Full Moon The bright side faces us almost completely.

@@T0@@Waning Gibbous@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@亏凸月@@T1@@
            @@T2@@超过一半是亮的，但此刻正在缩小。@@T3@@
@@T0@@Waning Gibbous@@T1@@\n.src: Waning Gibbous More than half is bright, but now it is shrinking.

@@T0@@Last Quarter@@T1@@\n @@.zh:
@@T0@@下弦月@@T1@@
            @@T2@@又有一半看起来是亮的，这一次出现在另一侧。@@T3@@
@@T0@@Last Quarter@@T1@@\n @@.src: Last Quarter Half looks bright again, this time on the other side.

@@T0@@Waning Crescent@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@残月@@T1@@
            @@T2@@回到新月之前，只剩下一小块明亮的部分。@@T3@@
@@T0@@Waning Crescent@@T1@@\n.src: Waning Crescent A tiny bright piece is left before new Moon.

Waxing means growing. Waning means shrin.zh: 盈表示变大，亏表示变小。
Waxing means growing. Waning means shrin.src: Waxing means growing. Waning means shrinking.

These are the two words that make the wh.zh: 正是这两个词，让整个循环变得更容易记住。
These are the two words that make the wh.src: These are the two words that make the whole cycle easier to remember.

The bright part is getting bigger night.zh: 明亮的区域一夜比一夜更大。
The bright part is getting bigger night.src: The bright part is getting bigger night after night.

New Moon → Crescent → First Quarter → Gi.zh: 新月 → 娥眉月 → 上弦月 → 盈凸月 → 满月
New Moon → Crescent → First Quarter → Gi.src: New Moon → Crescent → First Quarter → Gibbous → Full Moon

The bright part is getting smaller night.zh: 明亮的区域一夜比一夜更小。
The bright part is getting smaller night.src: The bright part is getting smaller night after night.

Full Moon → Gibbous → Last Quarter → Cre.zh: 满月 → 亏凸月 → 下弦月 → 残月 → 新月
Full Moon → Gibbous → Last Quarter → Cre.src: Full Moon → Gibbous → Last Quarter → Crescent → New Moon

A quarter Moon looks like half a circle..zh: 弦月看起来像半个圆。@@T0@@quarter@@T1@@（四分之一）一词指的是月亮走完了绕地球轨道的四分之一。
A quarter Moon looks like half a circle..src: A quarter Moon looks like half a circle. The word quarter means the Moon is a quarter of the way around Earth.

Moon phases are not Earth's shadow.zh: 月相并不是地球的影子造成的
Moon phases are not Earth's shadow.src: Moon phases are not Earth's shadow

A common mix-up is thinking phases happe.zh: 一个常见的误会是：以为月相的出现是因为地球挡住了太阳的光。通常并非如此。
A common mix-up is thinking phases happe.src: A common mix-up is thinking phases happen because Earth blocks the Sun. Usually it does not.

On most nights, the Moon is a little abo.zh: 在大多数夜晚，月亮都位于地球影子的略上方或略下方，因此月相只由阳光和我们的视角决定。
On most nights, the Moon is a little abo.src: On most nights, the Moon is a little above or below Earth's shadow, so the phase comes only from sunlight and our viewing angle.

Earth's shadow matters during a lunar ec.zh: 地球的影子只在月食时才起作用，在寻常的每月月相循环中并不起作用。
Earth's shadow matters during a lunar ec.src: Earth's shadow matters during a lunar eclipse, not during the ordinary monthly phase cycle.

Look at the Moon. Can you pick its name?.zh: 看看这个月亮，你能说出它的名字吗？
Look at the Moon. Can you pick its name?.src: Look at the Moon. Can you pick its name?

@@T0@@The Moon stays round.@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@月亮始终是圆的。@@T1@@
            @@T2@@发生变化的是阳光和我们的视角。@@T3@@
@@T0@@The Moon stays round.@@T1@@\n.src: The Moon stays round. It is the sunlight and our viewing angle that change.

@@T0@@Half is always lit by the Sun.@@T1.zh:
@@T0@@总有一半被太阳照亮。@@T1@@
            @@T2@@只是我们并不总能看全那被照亮的一半。@@T3@@
@@T0@@Half is always lit by the Sun.@@T1.src: Half is always lit by the Sun. We just cannot always see all of that lit half.

@@T0@@Waxing grows. Waning shrinks.@@T1@.zh:
@@T0@@盈则长大，亏则缩小。@@T1@@
            @@T2@@这一对词能帮助你跟上整个循环。@@T3@@
@@T0@@Waxing grows. Waning shrinks.@@T1@.src: Waxing grows. Waning shrinks. That one pair of words helps you follow the whole cycle.

Orbit view of the Sun, Earth, and Moon.src: Orbit view of the Sun, Earth, and Moon

meta.title: 月亮为什么会改变形状
meta.tagline: 一份生动直观的指南：新月、娥眉月、弦月与满月
meta.summary: 一篇适合小朋友的交互式讲解：拖动月亮绕地球运动，观察阳光的变化，认识八个月相名称，并用一个简单的月亮小游戏来检验自己。
highlights: 拖动月亮绕地球运动，实时观察明亮区域的变化。
用大而易点的相位卡片认识八个主要月相。
用浅显的语言弄清「盈」与「亏」的区别。
厘清普通月相与地球影子之间常见的误会。
最后用一个亲切的小测验，让孩子说出看到的月相名称。

The Moon is between Earth and the Sun, s.src: The Moon is between Earth and the Sun, so the bright half is facing away from us.

A thin bright smile is growing.src: A thin bright smile is growing

We can see a small bright crescent. Waxi.src: We can see a small bright crescent. Waxing means the bright part is growing.

Half the Moon looks bright. Quarter mean.zh: 月亮看起来有一半是亮的。弦表示月亮走完了绕地球轨道的四分之一。
Half the Moon looks bright. Quarter mean.src: Half the Moon looks bright. Quarter means the Moon is one quarter of the way around Earth.

Almost full and still growing.zh: 几乎全满，并且仍在变大

More than half is bright, and each night.zh: 超过一半是亮的，而且每一夜明亮的区域都还在继续变大。
More than half is bright, and each night.src: More than half is bright, and each night the bright part is still getting bigger.

The whole face looks bright.zh: 整个盘面看起来都是亮的

Only a thin crescent is bright before th.src: Only a thin crescent is bright before the Moon returns to new Moon.

On most nights, the Moon is a little abo.zh: 在大多数夜晚，月亮都位于地球影子的略上方或略下方，因此月相只由阳光和我们的视角决定。
On most nights, the Moon is a little abo.src: On most nights, the Moon is a little above or below Earth\'s shadow, so the phase comes only from sunlight and our viewing angle.

A lunar eclipse is special. Earth lines.zh: 月食则很特别。当地球与太阳、月亮排成一条直线时，地球的影子就真的落在了月亮上。
A lunar eclipse is special. Earth lines.src: A lunar eclipse is special. Earth lines up with the Sun and Moon, so Earth\'s shadow really does fall on the Moon.
